text:
The mistake we'd warn every Enoshima first-timer about: you ride the ¥500 Escar to the top, love the view, and only then find out the escalator runs one way. The way down is stairs 👇

👀 One small boat fixes this, and it surprised even us 👉 https://japanbystation.com/enoshima-without-the-stairs

📌 SAVE THIS CHECKLIST FOR A STAIR-LIGHT ENOSHIMA DAY

1️⃣ Before 10:00, phone the Benten-maru boat (0466-22-4141). It runs between Chigogafuchi and the foot of Benten Bridge, takes about 10 minutes and costs about ¥400, but it stops when the sea is rough.

2️⃣ If it's running: Escar up (¥500, 8:50 to 19:05), then on foot across the top to Chigogafuchi, and the boat back. You never climb back over the island.

3️⃣ If it's not: ride up, enjoy the Samuel Cocking Garden (free until 17:00) and the Sea Candle (¥800), then come back the way you came, slowly.

4️⃣ Lunch on the lower island. Tobicchi Honten, right after the bridge, is the shirasu-don place, and it hands out numbered tickets before opening at weekends. No credit cards.

5️⃣ Strollers have to be folded on the Escar, so a shore day on the mainland is the easier choice with a baby.

It feels like such a small detail, but it's the difference between a happy day out and a sore pair of knees on the train home.
